_doc: The KNOWN-DEVIATION ROSTER (docs/CONFORMANCE.md). Every rule cites its docs/CONFORMANCE-FINDINGS.md entry; status: capture = recording-closure limitation, deviation = DEVIATIONS.md-registered behavior, open = ledger-tracked port lead awaiting its fix. Rules match first-hit in order — keep specific rules above general ones. The runner prints per-rule hit counts every run: a rule whose count jumps an order of magnitude is a signal, not a mask.

rules.note: §terraform: village growth regrades the hill (main wave ~t=751, first edits ~t=500); (10,45) house z ground-snaps both sides, the port to the pristine plane (ledger MC2 take-2). A house's z has no source but terrain — any (10,45) z diff is closure by mechanism.

§l30-terrain: the (14,x) markers sit on the retail 2176 plateau the port heightfield lacks (12 of 14 exactly -1664). Load-time-vs-runtime check still owed — flip to open if the load-time raise proves portable.
